data.name: Ophel
data.gender_notes: Ophel is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word ‘ophel’, meaning ‘help’ or ‘comfort’. In the Bible, Ophel is the name of a location and a woman mentioned in the Book of Jeremiah. Ophel is a symbol of hope and solace in times of sorrow. The name Ophel carries the meaning “Help, Comfort” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ophel usually hope their child will grow to embody help, comfort and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with comfort and hope, inspiring strength and resilience.
data.etymology: Ophel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Help, Comfort.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ophel total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: אופל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אופל (Ophel) - שם שמקורו בלשון העברית. במקרא, המונח 'אופל' משמעו יער, ערבה, או תנועת רוח, (1 בספר ישעיה, 2:13. 4:4). שם זה, נספח לשם עברי שפירושו 'לבד' או 'לבדות'.

in_greek.name: Ὀφὴλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὀφὴλ (Ophēl) - ὀνομασία ἀπ' εἰς ἑλληνισμόν τῆς Ἑβραϊκῆς λέξεως. Ὁ Ὀφὴλ, ὀνομάζει ἕνα πρόσωπον, τὸ ὁποῖον ἔχει στενὴν σχέσιν μετὰ τὸν Ἰησοῦν. Ὄνομα τοῦτο, ἔχει στενὴν σύνδεσιν, μετὰ τὴν Ἑλληνισμόν τῆς Ἑβραϊκῆς Γραφῆς.

in_latin.name: Ophel
in_latin.long_meaning: Ophel - nomen Hebraicum, in Latinum translatus. Ophel, nomen prophetae, qui in Evangelio secundum Ioannem, describitur. Nomen Ophel, significat tenebrae, obscuritas, vel quietem.

in_english.name: Ophel
in_english.meaning: name meaning is shadow or darkness
in_english.long_meaning: Ophel is a name with Hebrew origin, derived from the word 'Ophel' meaning a shade, shadow or darkness, possibly referring to a quiet or secluded place. The name Ophel is mentioned in the Bible, specifically in the New Testament, in the context of a prophet. Ophel is also associated with spiritual significance, representing a state of quiet contemplation or spiritual darkness. This name is suitable for parents seeking a unique and meaningful name with biblical roots.

pronunciation.biblical: Ophel (Hebrew: עֹפֵל), pronounced as 'OH-fel' in modern English
